permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Voice input from the glasses mic array, streamed to the wearer's own Mac for transcription.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Fallback voice input from the phone mic when the glasses mic is unavailable.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: WebSocket link to the wearer's own Mac (the assistant brain). No third-party servers.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Your position is sent to your own Mac for local context and walking/cycling guidance. When you ask for nearby places or explicitly request navigation, your Mac may send the search query and route endpoints to its configured routing provider.
